result.description:
Job Position : System Analyst
Location: Parramatta NSW 2150
Company: Discount Building Material Pty Ltd
Salary: $79,000 – $89,000 per annum
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About Us
Discount Building Material Pty Ltd, located in Parramatta NSW 2150, is an Australian technology-driven building materials platform connecting leading manufacturers with a nationwide network of resellers. Through a single digital portal, the company streamlines wholesale ordering, delivers accurate product information, and enables seamless supplier integration to improve procurement efficiency across the building materials industry.

Key Duties
• Consult with business stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document business and system requirements for ICT solutions.
• Review existing information systems, business processes, and workflows to identify
opportunities for improved functionality, efficiency, and performance.
• Prepare functional specifications, process models, workflow diagrams, and technical
documentation to support system development and implementation.
• Evaluate and recommend system enhancements and ICT solutions that align with business objectives and operational requirements.
• Collaborate with software developers, project managers, and external service providers throughout the design, development, and implementation of business systems.
• Coordinate system testing activities, validate business requirements, and ensure
implemented solutions satisfy functional and operational expectations.
• Monitor system performance, investigate system issues, and recommend continuous
improvements to optimise reliability and business outcomes.
• Develop user documentation, provide implementation support, and assist with user training to promote effective adoption of new and enhanced systems.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
• A minimum of one (1) year of relevant post-qualification experience in systems analysis, business analysis, information systems, or a related field.
• Demonstrated experience in analysing business requirements, evaluating ICT systems, preparing functional specifications, and supporting the delivery of system solutions.
• Sound knowledge of systems analysis methodologies, business process modelling, systems integration, software development life cycle (SDLC), and system testing practices.
• Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams.

What We Offer
• Competitive annual salary, based on qualifications and experience.
• Opportunity to work on innovative business systems and digital transformation projects.
• Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.
• Supportive, collaborative, and technology-focused workplace.
• Stable employment opportunity with a growing Australian business.

How to Apply
If you are an experienced System Analyst with a passion for improving business systems and delivering effective solutions, we encourage you to apply.
